summary: OceanPal Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing that it will be unable to file its Annual Report on Form 20-F for FY2025 within the Rule 12b-25 extension period, citing an ongoing review of certain accounting matters. The registrant (OceanPal) provides no deal terms, no board recommendation, and no advisor. This is a routine late-filing notice with no event-driven special situation; the disclosure simply updates the status of the delayed annual report.
